disclosure.heading: El Ahram Co. For Printing And Packing (EPPK.CA) - Listing Committee Decision
disclosure.content:
Company Name : El Ahram Co. For Printing And Packing
ISIN Code : EGS360A1C011
Reuters Code : EPPK.CA
Content :
The Listing Committee held on 27/09/2026 decided to continue the suspension of trading on the shares of Al Ahram Printing and Packaging Company until the company provides the Egyptian Exchange with a detailed and feasible future plan that meets the requirements referred to in the statement issued by the Financial Regulatory Authority and published on the Exchange’s screens on 07/09/2026.

The plan must include the following:
• An explanation of the impact of the enforcement measures carried out against the company’s assets and equipment.
• An assessment of the company’s ability to continue its operations, as well as its available operational and production capacity.
• The actual measures to be taken to address the consequences resulting from such enforcement measures and to secure the necessary financing.
• A specific and detailed timetable for implementing these measures.
The company must also provide an updated financial position accompanied by an auditor’s report.
